diff2ai.text: Delete query's retryCount condition is not scoped to SMS reminders - the OR makes the second branch match reminders of every method (EMAIL, WHATSAPP, etc.), so the SMS cron job could delete non-SMS reminders
Retry threshold is inconsistent and drops reminders after only two attempts - gt: 1 deletes a reminder once retryCount reaches 2, so a reminder gets only two failed attempts before removal

The retry-count update inside the catch block can throw and abort the whole loop - prisma.workflowReminder.update runs inside catch without its own try/catch, causing remaining reminders to not be processed if the DB call fails
Duplicated retry-increment logic uses read-then-write instead of an atomic increment - overlapping cron runs could overwrite each other's counts, should use Prisma's atomic increment

Empty `updateMany` with `{}` does not bump `updatedAt` timestamp, and it touches all calendars under the credential including ones that were not refreshed, causing an extra DB write on every webhook-driven cache refresh
Cache `updatedAt` is not refreshed on upsert - existing rows show migration time as last update, and raw SQL upserts won't update `updatedAt` because `@updatedAt` is only applied by Prisma Client
Cache deletion authorization check only covers personal credentials (userId: user.id), excluding team and delegation credentials even though the dropdown shows delete option for them
Cache deletion handler throws generic `Error` instead of `TRPCError` with proper code like `NOT_FOUND` or `FORBIDDEN`, resulting in 500 errors
Cache deletion uses direct Prisma calls instead of the repository pattern that the commit message claims to have adopted
Timestamp is formatted with hardcoded 'en-US' locale, ignoring user's locale and timezone preferences
`delegationCredentialId || null` coercion can hide a type mismatch
Test script uses `sed -i ''` which fails on GNU/Linux sed (macOS-only)
Test script's `ENV_FILE="../.env"` depends on current working directory
Test script reuses existing tmole session by reading a log that may not exist
Unrelated tooling changes (test script and dev:cron change) are bundled into the feature PR

GET request changes subscription state, enabling CSRF and email-scanner triggering - the unsubscribe action modifies notification level on GET which can be triggered by email scanners, prefetchers, and cross-site img tags without user intent
Nil dereference when no TopicUser row exists - TopicUser.find_by returns nil if user has never visited the topic, causing NoMethodError on notification_level access
TopicUser.save! bypasses TopicUser.change which handles MessageBus notification updates and side effects
Unauthenticated users and missing topics are not handled - current_user.id is dereferenced without verifying ensure_logged_in covers the unsubscribe action
unsubscribe_url may be missing in other mailers (digest and similar) that pass add_unsubscribe_link: true but don't provide the URL, causing I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument or broken links
post.topic.unsubscribe_url is a relative URL from Topic#url, so it is not absolute in emails
Unescaped triple-stash rendering of title via {{{stopNotificiationsText}}} renders unescaped HTML, relying on assumption that fancyTitle is sanitized server-side
Controller property name is misspelled as 'stopNotificiationsText' instead of 'stopNotificationsText'
Imported raw HTML is stored and rendered without sanitization, allowing stored XSS attacks through feed content or remote pages
Referer check is spoofable and the referer is injected into inline JS without proper JS-string escaping, allowing script injection
SSRF vulnerability via open-uri on user-influenced URLs - accepts file paths and pipe commands, lacks scheme validation and timeouts
Embed view crashes when topic has no posts due to nil @topic_view, and invalid ERB syntax 'end if' with no condition causes SyntaxError
contents << mutates the argument string which raises on frozen strings and mutates caller's string unexpectedly
Feed items with blank content crash the poller - i.content.scrub raises NoMethodError when content is nil, and one failing item aborts the whole poll
Origin check in embed.js uses substring match (indexOf) which accepts any origin that is a substring of the URL including empty string
Retrieval throttle has race condition - setnx followed by expire is not atomic, crash between calls leaves key that never expires
absolutize_urls does not handle protocol-relative //host links correctly and appends port to frozen/interpolated string
Rule list view no longer shows creating/deleting states - newly created rules are invisible until Prometheus catches up, and the operation prop of GrafanaRuleListItem is never set by any caller
Edit link for Grafana rules loses the returnTo parameter, causing navigation back from rule view to not return user to the list
Ability checks are OR-combined across ruler and prom sources which can grant stale or wrong access - the more permissive result wins when both ruler and prom rules exist

Grafana prom ability hook reports a rule without a folder as supported and loaded - when rule is undefined, useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable returns loading: false, causing MaybeSupported to become AlwaysSupported
Federated rules are no longer detected - isFederated is hardcoded to false instead of using isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), allowing data-source federated rules to be edited or deleted in UI
Fragile test assertions - test asserts exactly 4 menu items which breaks whenever a menu item is added

enableSqlExpressions always returns false due to inverted logic - `enabled := !IsEnabledGlobally(...)` causes the function to return false regardless of flag state, making the feature flag ineffective
Potential nil dereference if h.features is nil when calling the features check in enableSqlExpressions
Stub DB methods TablesList and Execute return generic 'not implemented' error, but other construction paths like NewSQLCommand are not gated, leaving SQL command reachable
Error message 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' is misleading since the feature is disabled, not unimplemented
Error handling doesn't use project's errutil conventions, causing callers to be unable to classify the error properly (likely returns HTTP 500 instead of 4xx)
Test matcher checks wrong substring indexes (uses 3-5 instead of 4-6) and has inverted condition, causing correct IDs to be rejected and incorrect ones accepted
Null check validates wrong variable - checks grantType instead of rawTokenId, so null rawTokenId is never rejected
Token ID encoding can throw 500 error when grant type is null or unsupported, affecting implicit/hybrid flows, permission grants, and token-exchange variants
getShouldUseLightweightToken calls session.getContext().getClient() which may be null in some flows
Shortcut collision detection happens after maps are overwritten - duplicates should be detected explicitly on put using putIfAbsent
Compile error: UsernameForm calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the signature was changed to require a UserModel parameter
Passkeys no longer set up on the initial login form when no user is set - isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(user) returns false when user is null, breaking the main login page passkey functionality
Missing @Override annotation on shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators method in WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator, which could miss signature mismatches
Test try/catch pattern is convoluted - findElement throws NoSuchElementException and the nullValue() assertion is never reached; should use Assert.assertThrows or findElements(...).isEmpty() instead
Default `queued` timestamp is evaluated once at import time, so every `AssignmentSource` that doesn't pass `queued` gets the same stale timestamp, making the field meaningless
The `queued` datetime field breaks JSON serialization when the task is queued because `asdict` returns a `datetime` and Celery's JSON serializer may not handle it

`sync_assignee_outbound` passes the new `assignment_source` kwarg to installations that don't accept it, causing TypeError in existing integration implementations that don't declare `**kwargs` or this parameter
The abstract signature of `sync_assignee_outbound` was not updated to include the new parameter
`sync_status_outbound` gains the parameter only in the abstract signature but subclasses may not accept it

`from_dict` doesn't validate field types - `cls(**input_dict)` accepts any value types like a string `integration_id`, causing `should_sync` comparison to silently never match and loop protection to fail

Abstract hook build_occurrence_and_event_data added to StatefulDetectorHandler breaks MetricAlertDetectorHandler instantiation because it leaves the new hook and existing abstract methods unimplemented, causing TypeError when instantiated
Duplicate group-key detection was removed and the new dict can silently overwrite results when a handler's evaluate_group_key_value returns a result whose group_key differs from the iterated key
PriorityLevel conversion may raise ValueError for DetectorPriorityLevel values with no PriorityLevel counterpart if the enums diverge, aborting evaluation for the whole packet
